test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 13 July 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, 'PIZZA' is written as 'QJAAB' and 'BLACK' is written as ‘CMBDL’. How will 'BUZZY' be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b1ef5af07dc7cdface0347994bbc6f824cbda2bac27bcab0cb4cf07968dfa00.png] 

The logic followed here is:

Letters + 1.

'PIZZA' is written as 'QJAAB'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dfdc92948e46998dbf4d40cd1f71c0958efec5dcc19764ff8eddb28d57ad06b4.png] 

 

'BLACK' is written as ‘CMBDL’.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0aa1ee296d03c47c81a1bdd97cdb66d5c62e1b984f18d553680c306a3b4ba37e.png] 

 

Similarly, for 'BUZZY'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1d723b11cd2b2131a124c13d621d8fdbfb7def30301ca448f548b931d7c582ec.png] 

So, 'BUZZY' will be written as 'CVAAZ'.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
